about_the_game:
Gerrit's Games is a basic yet twisted adventure that will keep you on your toes! Inspired by Baldi's Basics, this meta game turns the concept of educational gaming on it's head. Navigate through a surreal environment with a bald character who defies all logic and expectations. Your basic objective is simple: collect glitches and survive the increasingly chaotic challenges that await you!

Key Features:

🧩 Challenges: Stay out of the hands of a variety of enemies and puzzles to progress through the game.

👻 Stealth and Strategy: Outsmart Gerrit and his minions by using stealth and clever tactics

💯 Randomness: No game is ever the game with all the countless of events!

⁉ Unique Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a dark and twisted world filled with unexpected surprises.

With a big amount of different art styles this game is very unique and funny.

Get ready to test your wits and nerves in these horrifying adventures!

short_description: Gerrit's Games is a weird horror game. Inspired by Baldi's Basics, this meta game challenges players to navigate a surreal environment, outsmart a bald character and solve a variety of puzzles. With its unique atmosphere and challenging gameplay. The game offers a horrifying and humorous adventure.
